name: invoice-service
description: Invoices, line items, tax and status transitions for a billing team.
walkthrough: Status transitions are enforced in src/routes/invoices.ts (requireStatus), not in the service, so InvoiceService.issue/pay/void will happily move an invoice from any state; ask where the rule belongs and what breaks when a second caller (a job, another route) uses the service.

Two error shapes: HttpError and errorHandler in src/lib/errors.ts reply { error: { code, message } }, while src/auth.ts replies { error: "unauthorized" } / { error: "forbidden" } directly; ask what a client has to do to handle both.

No index on invoices.customer_id (src/db.ts MIGRATIONS) while the list route filters on customer_id and does ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC (src/repositories/invoices.ts list); ask what the query plan looks like at a million invoices and which composite index fits.

InvoiceService.pay (src/services/invoices.ts) calls PaymentProvider.charge before updating status and sends no idempotency key, so a crash or retry between the charge and the UPDATE can double-charge; ask how they would make it safe.
